instructions: MedControl: medical data of one patient (lab results, medications, imaging, diary, history, appointments). Start with get_patient_profile. Lab values are in SI units, dates are YYYY-MM-DD. This is patient data, not prescriptions: do not give medical recommendations in place of a doctor; point out what is important to discuss with the treating doctor.

args.markerKey: marker key, for example ALT, HGB

get_patient_profile.title: Patient profile
get_patient_profile.description: A summary of the patient in one text: medical background, treatment protocol, current therapy, latest lab results, milestones, diary. The same context the built-in AI assistant gets. Start with it.

list_lab_markers.title: Lab markers
list_lab_markers.description: Catalog of markers (key, name, unit, blood or urine) with the date of the latest result and the number of results. The keys are needed for get_lab_results.

get_lab_results.title: Lab results
get_lab_results.description: Lab results with the reference range in effect (custom, catalog or from the lab report; field ref_source) and the range of the lab report. Filters: marker key (from list_lab_markers), period. By default the latest 200 results.

get_medications.title: Medications and doses
get_medications.description: Current medications (doses, schedule) and dose marks for the last days (30 by default).

get_diary.title: Wellbeing diary
get_diary.description: Diary entries: wellbeing 1–5, symptom scales 0–3, blood pressure, pulse, weight (kg), temperature (°C), steps, note. By default the last 30 days.

get_appointments.title: Appointments
get_appointments.description: Planned and past appointments: date, time, doctor, place, notes, visit questions.

get_history.title: Treatment history
get_history.description: Milestones: surgeries, radiation therapy, histology, studies, consultations, documents, with dates, notes and a list of files (without content).

get_imaging.title: Imaging
get_imaging.description: CT, MRI and PET studies: imaging reports, response assessment (RECIST), lesions and their sizes by date.

get_contacts.title: Doctors and contacts
get_contacts.description: Doctors, front desks and other contacts: name, role, clinic, phones, email, address, notes.

search.title: Search everything
search.description: Full-text search across notes, history, document texts, imaging, appointments, diary, infusions, AI answers, medications and contacts.

add_note.title: Add a note
add_note.description: Writes a note to the Notes section (Markdown). Use it for conclusions and summaries the user asked to save. The note gets the tag "ai-agent".

add_diary_entry.title: Add to the diary
add_diary_entry.description: Adds values to the diary for a day (what is not passed stays unchanged): wellbeing 1–5, blood pressure, pulse, weight in kg, temperature in °C, note (added to the existing one).
